I'm Hirai, editor-in-chief of Giant Shadow Weekly.
I'm glad you came.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0085.json:p0/k698; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: How do you and Otsuka know each other, Hirai?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0085.json:p0/k726; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Well, if it isn't Fujiwara.
What are you doing here?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0081.json:p0/k99; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Come and negotiate alone.
It would be difficult to talk with that man Fujiwara around.

entries.en: While escaping from the flying monsters, I met a badly wounded young man in the back of a truck. He said a monster appeared after he fought with his girlfriend and they parted, and he lost sight of her. Apparently, her name is Kumi.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k114; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: I met Kumi, the girlfriend the young man said he had become separated from. She deeply regretted fighting with him; apparently, his name is Naoki. I parted ways with her afterward. Has she managed to find him again...?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k116; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
I met Kumi again.
She seems to have hurt herself and cannot walk. She asked me to find Naoki for her.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k119; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Naoki was badly injured when I last saw him.
Is he safe now...?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k120; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
I found Naoki. He is indeed badly injured.
I should tell Kumi.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k121; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
I told Kumi about Naoki.
I'll carry her to him on my back.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k122; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
I witnessed Naoki and Kumi make their vows.
With a trembling hand, Naoki slipped a ring onto Kumi's finger.
They seem to be resting now.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k123; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: The research vessel sank. A photograph of First Mate Oda and Dr. Fukazawa was floating on the sea.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k245; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: First Mate Oda seems interested in Dr. Fukazawa. I agreed to help him with a request concerning her.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k249; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: First Mate Oda asked me to find out how Dr. Fukazawa feels about him. Apparently, she is near the lifeboat.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k250; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Dr. Fukazawa seemed fond of First Mate Oda. I must tell him.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k251; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: The first mate has apparently decided to take the plunge and give Dr. Fukazawa a letter. I'll deliver it to her. Incidentally, the letter does not seem to be sealed.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k252; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Dr. Fukazawa entrusted me with her reply.
I must deliver it to First Mate Oda. Incidentally, this letter is also unsealed.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k253; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: I gave First Mate Oda Dr. Fukazawa's reply. Apparently, they will meet at the bow tomorrow morning, where she will tell him how she feels.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k254; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: I am to meet up with Mukojima, a member of Editor-in-Chief Hirai's staff. He is reportedly at a convenience store west of the Ebine Publishing building.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k299; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
I met up with Mukojima, who was frightened inside the convenience store.
An email from Otsuka says W&P still exists.
Parting ways with Editor-in-Chief Hirai and the others, we head for Mizuna City.
